reports.title: Elanco Animal Health Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: •Full Year 2026 Guidance
section: ◦Raising revenue guidance to $5.155 billion to $5.18 billion, or approximately 8% organic constant currency growth
◦Raising Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $1.05 billion to $1.065 billion, a year-over-year increase of 17% at midpoint
◦Raising Adjusted EPS guidance to $1.17 to $1.20, a year-over-year increase of 26% at midpoint
◦Improving year-end net leverage ratio target to approximately 2.9x Adjusted EBITDA with accelerated capital allocation flexibility
